metadata.description: Yili Yang's Claude Code skills in one plugin: a thinking framework, writing in his own voice, plain technical English, topic briefings, purchase research, interviewing before answering, and wardrobe judgment.

plugins.name: yili-skills
plugins.description: Seven skills: prompt-to-think (structured reasoning), write-like-myself (writing in Yili Yang's voice), talk-standard-tech-eng (plain, stable technical English), expertise (sourced, dated topic briefings), research-before-buy (purchase research), interview-before-answer (learn how the user thinks, answer through their lens, then challenge it), wardrobe (judge a clothing buy against the person and what they own).
